Why call it grεpsilon█?

grεpsilon█ is a portmanteau of `grep` and `epsilon`.

  • grep is a command-line utility for searching text, given a regular expression.
  • Epsilon refers to two concepts: the permittivity of a dielectric (in physics), and represents a tiny quantity (in mathematics).
